# Exact dependency lock for CI (Linux, CPython 3.11). Do not edit by hand.
#
# CI must be deterministic: every run installs the same pymc, nutpie, numba,
# pytensor and arviz, so a green build on Monday means the same thing as one
# on Friday. pyproject.toml only sets lower bounds, so without this file each
# run would resolve whatever the latest releases are.
#
# Regenerate with:
#    uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --python-version 3.11 --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --generate-hashes -o requirements/ci-lock.txt
#
# Bumping the lock is a deliberate change: regenerate it and commit it on its
# own, so the version change is reviewable apart from any code change.
